method: Direct Node ESM import of current pure generator. validateGeneratedMap on returned graph; existing checkConnectivity on deterministic adapter; independent directed BFS from first-layer authored entry. No browser, game session, save injection, full suite or build.
limitations: Generator rejects candidate graphs internally before returning: 100 quality passes are post-filter outputs, not first-attempt acceptance rates.
Graph reachability ignores player HP, card cost, lock conditions, event outcomes and ability to defeat BOSS; it does not prove gameplay completion or evacuation usability.
Node types are map containers: battle count excludes battles started by events or other node contents.
Seed set matches batch-0..99 in existing generator test and is reproducible, not a random population sample.
